title: Phát âm & Shadowing — Câu so sánh

sentences.text: The old wooden bridge in our small village is narrower than the new concrete one.
Rents in the centre are higher than rents in the suburbs.
My grandmother’s old recipes are more interesting than the recipes in modern cookery books today.
Public transport in Singapore is more efficient than public transport in most Asian cities today.
Coal power stations are less popular than modern wind farms in many European countries today.
A university degree is not as valuable as real work experience in some modern industries.
Air pollution remains the most serious environmental problem in many large Asian capital cities today.
The old quarter is the busiest area in Hanoi at weekends.
The new electric buses start earlier than the old diesel ones on my street every morning.
Young workers in this factory learn faster than the older staff.
The new nurses treat patients more gently than the older staff.
Village children learn English as easily as children in the city.
Doctors at the new clinic explain the treatment the most clearly of all the staff there.
Air quality in the industrial district is far worse than in the quiet coastal towns.
My grandfather’s old radio still works better than the cheap new one from the market.
